Ancient means it is never grab-bag or shop stock: executed (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b15.py b15-pool) the relic is absent from the 126-relic transcribed grab bag and its only ported grant path is events/neow.py -- which is also the C# situation (SmallCapsule is a Neow option). AfterObtained.issue: Rollup of guards G1 and N1 per binding rule 4. The RELIC the sim pulls and the stream draw it burns are both correct (N1); the divergence is that `RewardsCmd.OfferCustom` is a take-or-skip screen and the port auto-keeps -- see guard G1 for the mechanism and the evidence. LIVE, grade B.

guards.what: G1: `RewardsCmd.OfferCustom(Owner, [new RelicReward(Owner)])` (SmallCapsule.cs:15-18) is a reward SCREEN the player may decline; after_obtained grants the pulled relic unconditionally
guards.issue:
MECHANISM AUTO-KEEP, one verdict at every site (binding rule 3). RE-VERDICTED from deliberate-divergence to gap by the relic fix pass (2026-07-26); the old rationale's premise -- 'the house rule for NON-CHOICE relic offers' -- is false, because these are choice offers.
THE OFFERS ARE DECLINABLE. `RewardsCmd.OfferCustom` (RewardsCmd.cs:47-50) is `new RewardsSet(player).WithCustomRewards(rewards).Offer()` with no skip suppression, and `grep -rn WithSkippingDisallowed src/` returns exactly TWO lines in the whole source: the definition (RewardsSet.cs:115) and its one caller, NeowsBones.cs:43. Neow's Bones is therefore the ONLY non-declinable relic offer in the game; CallingBell.cs:31, ToyBox.cs:96, SmallCapsule.cs:15, LostCoffer.cs:22, Orrery.cs:27 and GlassEye.cs:32 are plain skippable sets, as is the ordinary combat/boss reward screen that BlackStar.cs:23, LavaRock.cs:61 and WongosMysteryTicket.cs:101 append RelicRewards to.
IT IS NOT AN IDENTICAL OBSERVABLE (binding rule 2), for two independent reasons. (1) A DECLINE IS WRITTEN INTO RUN HISTORY: `RelicReward.OnSkipped` (RelicReward.cs:117-123) does `RelicChoices.Add(new ModelChoiceHistoryEntry(_relic.Id, wasPicked: false))`, and the sim's own conformance runner READS that field (sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:429-432), while `sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:435-466 _reconcile_node_relics` is a bespoke replay-time WORKAROUND that deletes relics the sim auto-granted and the save says were not picked. A divergence that needs a workaround is not an identical observable. (2) PICKUP EFFECTS FIRE UNCONDITIONALLY: in C# `AfterObtained` runs inside `RelicReward.OnSelect` (RelicReward.cs:109-115), i.e. only when the player TAKES the relic, whereas the sim's `run.add_relic` fires `after_obtained` at screen-generation time (sts2_rl/run.py:546-553, the call is sts2_rl/run.py:552), so a relic the player would have declined still runs its pickup effect.
STILL deliberate-divergence, and correct: relic/neows_bones G2 (the one `WithSkippingDisallowed` site) and the up-to-N card screens relic/claws and relic/glass_eye, whose purposes `transform_optional` / `card_reward` ARE in sts2_rl/driver.py:77 SKIPPABLE_PURPOSES so the driver really does offer a decline. Agrees with audit/records/event/drowning_beacon.json mechanism EV-4 (gap, 8 event sites). Rule 7: RewardsCmd.cs, RelicReward.cs, RewardsSet.cs, conformance/runner.py, run.py, rewards.py and driver.py are cited here and not all hashed by this record.
AT THIS SITE (LIVE, grade B): SmallCapsule.cs:13-19 offers exactly one RelicReward; sts2_rl/relics/small_capsule.py:15-16 calls run.obtain_relic_from_grab_bag, which pulls AND adds. EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b15.py b15-misc): `run.add_relic('small_capsule')` yields relics ['burning_blood', 'small_capsule', 'blood_vial'] and moves the grab bag 96 -> 95 -- the C# TAKE branch. The SKIP branch (relic not added, bag still 95, blood_vial's after_obtained not run, a wasPicked:false history entry written) is unreachable in the sim. Small Capsule is a ported Neow option (sts2_rl/events/neow.py), so both sides are reachable. Note the pull itself is correct and must stay: a declined Small Capsule relic still LEAVES the bag in C#, because Populate ran before OnSkipped.

guards.what: N1: `new RelicReward(base.Owner)` -- the no-rarity constructor -- and which RNG stream its rarity roll comes off
guards.rationale: RelicReward(Player) (RelicReward.cs:56-59) leaves _rarity at RelicRarity.None, so Populate takes the `_rarity == RelicRarity.None` arm and calls `RelicFactory.PullNextRelicFromFront(base.Player)` with no rarity and no rng override (RelicReward.cs:81-91). The sim's obtain_relic_from_grab_bag(rarity_rng=None) reaches pull_relic_from_front with rarity=None, which rolls the rarity on run.rewards_rng (run.py:587-589) -- and run.rewards_rng is the per-player Rewards stream (run.py:271-274), which is precisely what the default PullNextRelicFromFront(player) overload uses (pull_relic_from_front's own docstring cites RelicFactory.cs:28/82). So this is NOT an instance of PROMPT.md bug class 16's silent-stream fallback: the stream is named on both sides and it is the same one. Checked deliberately because relic/calling_bell G2 is the failure mode here -- a relic-granting relic that never burns the pull -- and this port does burn it (executed: grab bag 96 -> 95). Rule 7: RelicReward.cs, RewardsCmd.cs and run.py are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N2: no `undo_after_obtained`, although the pickup mutates run state outside the relic itself (it adds a second relic)
guards.rationale: PROMPT.md v6 item 3 (rule-3 resolution): the ABSENCE of undo_after_obtained is faithful at every site -- the helper has no C# counterpart (nothing in the game un-picks a relic), so a sim lacking it is not diverging from the source, which is the only question this audit asks. OPERATIONAL CONSEQUENCE worth flagging (a tooling defect, not a fidelity gap): the conformance runner grants a node's relic and then swaps it for the one the save says was really picked (sts2_rl/conformance/runner.py:461, 694 -- verified by grep per binding rule 8), and a discarded Small Capsule leaves BOTH the free relic in run.relics AND the burned grab-bag pull behind, which shifts every later relic pull in the run. Distinct from the mango/strawberry family (PROMPT.md v6 item 3's second half), whose undo EXISTS and clamps; here there is none at all. Rule 7: leans on relics/base.py:143-150 and conformance/runner.py, neither hashed here.
